chunks: "In istinja, what appears on the anal area is washed, and the fingertip should not be inserted into it."

key_terms.الشَّرْجِ: the anal opening or anal area

ai.seo_question: What is to be washed in istinja, and should the finger be inserted into the anal passage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding istinja after relieving oneself. It instructs that only the outwardly visible area of the anus is to be washed, and that the fingertip should not be inserted inside.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.60 - Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) said:
"In istinja, what appears on the anal area should be washed, but the fingers should not be inserted into it."
